description: Canonical registry of Traditional Bible story anchors. Each entry represents one narrative unit that may be generated as a Traditional story. scriptureAnchorId is the primary uniqueness key. Version 2: expanded for Opus 4.6 generation pipeline.
legacy_anchors_note: Anchors used by legacy stories (IDs 801-834) are preserved below. New Opus 4.6 stories (IDs 1000-1999) draw from the full registry.
